user.title: Connect to Ho-Smart / eMACROS receiver
user.description: Enter the receiver address and your My Hosmart app credentials. Home Assistant uses the account during setup to retrieve the receiver's local-control key and cloud identity. Your My Hosmart email and password are not saved.

error.no_devices: The My Hosmart account did not return any receivers.
error.cannot_match_device: The account devices could not be matched to this receiver. Verify the receiver IP address.

init.title: Receiver schedule
init.description: One save configures Default and Ch. 1–4. Expand a channel only when it needs an override. Arm/disarm changes zone detection; tone-only muting is not supported by the verified HS006W receiver. Old master-volume/power schedules are retained.

default.name: Default
default.description: Applies to all channels set to Use Default.

data_description.action: Arm/disarm changes detection. Legacy entire-receiver mute/power options apply to every channel, never to just one tone.

ch1.name: Ch. 1
ch1.description: Use Default, always stay armed, or override with individual hours and Arm/Disarm.

data_description.action: Arming keeps detection active; disarming can stop the alarm and its cloud notifications. A separate tone-only mute is not supported on verified HS006W firmware.
